name: Loom
tagline: The AI coding assistant that remembers your project
description:
Loom is an AI-powered coding assistant that builds and maintains a persistent memory of your project using Anna's LLM.

How the AI works:
• start_session: Loom scans your VS Code workspace (file structure, git history, open files) and uses Anna's LLM to synthesize a structured project memory — your stack, current focus, key decisions, what you tried and abandoned, and exactly where you left off.
• chat: Every conversation injects the full AI-generated memory into the system prompt, giving the LLM complete project context from the first message. The memory auto-updates every 4 exchanges.

The problem it solves: Every AI coding tool today forgets everything when the session ends. Developers waste time re-explaining their stack, decisions, and progress — every single time. Loom fixes this permanently.

Requires: FlowDev VS Code extension (free) to bridge Loom with your local workspace.
author: FlowDev
